rate_offered.notes: Printed '(1.90%)P-2.85% לתום תקופת הפיקדון' in the offered nominal rate; rate type 'משתנה', linkage 'לא צמוד'; adjusted '1.9000% :לתום תקופת הפיקדון', common 'P-2.85% :לתום תקופת הפיקדון'; exit points 'משיכה בהודעה של 33 יום מראש' (stations: no); break 'אין אפשרות שבירה'; renewal 'לא קיים' / 'לא מתחדש'. Account type 174, product 759. The rate column labels the rate 'לתום תקופת הפיקדון'. This row as printed: 10,000-249,999: nominal '(1.90%)P-2.85% לתום תקופת הפיקדון', adjusted '1.9000% :לתום תקופת הפיקדון', common 'P-2.85% :לתום תקופת הפיקדון'. Read 2026-11-09 from the data the page loads (https://apps.fibi.co.il/bff-depositmanagement/api/v1/fibi/depositDetails/31, 'effectiveDate' 2026-11-09, 'prime' 4.75); the 447 row is in the family 'פיקדונות מקובלים'. The exit column's 'משיכה בהודעה של 33 יום מראש' is recorded as exit points with no fixed interval (`exit_points.exists` true, `every_months` null): a withdrawal on advance notice, as the bank's own exit column prints it; 447 makes the bank show its exit points (BANK-27); the bank's data marks no stations for it.

tax_bucket.notes: Unlinked shekel deposit: interest taxed at 15% of the nominal interest (TXI-03); 'linked' means CPI or exchange rate, so an unlinked or prime-linked shekel deposit is in this bucket (TXI-04); the bank withholds 15% (TXI-08). Copied from the rule base (TXI-03's source, read 2026-10-25), not re-read today.
